description: Pistes et bandes cyclables CAVF is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'agglomération du Val de Fensch. This document presents all the trails and cycle paths in the Val de Fensch territory. Coverage: Communauté d'agglomération du Val de Fensch. The portal shows the English title as "CAVF cycle paths and tracks" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'agglomération du Val de Fensch. The listing shows 1 download or service links in 7Z. The listing shows 2023-11-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
